title: Silent Runner
statementMarkdown:
A legacy runner process broadcasts its identifier in **base 2** only. The identifier on screen is the decimal value $42$.

**Transmit the binary string the runner is broadcasting** (digits only, no prefix).
hints: Subtract the largest power of two you can, repeatedly: 32, then 16, 8, 4, 2, 1.
Your answer should contain exactly six digits.
